description: GET /inspect/db?table=<name>&limit=<n> on the running app — assert PERSISTED state in the live tier. `table` must be a real table name (the app's Room schema JSONs and @Entity classes are in-repo) — the device validates it strictly against `sqlite_master` before ever touching a query, so an unknown name 404s rather than running arbitrary SQL. Rows are capped by `limit` (device-side default/max apply regardless of what's requested). Returns { table, columns, rows, rowCount }. Requires connect_live.

port.description: Inspector port (default: the connect_live session port, else 9500).

table.description: Exact table name (see the app's Room schema JSONs / @Entity classes).

name: db_query
title: Read rows from one SQLite table (read-only, bounded)
